description.fun: Raikou is one of three Pokémon that died when lightning set Johto's Brass Tower ablaze 150 years ago and were revived by Ho-Oh as the legendary beasts, and it stands for the lightning itself. A proverb says it came down from the sky with a bolt, and its thunderous roar shakes air and ground alike. Designer Muneo Saitō settled on a tiger's look after early versions that even carried a drum.
description.guide: An Electric-type Legendary Pokémon, one of Johto's three legendary beasts revived by Ho-Oh after the Brass Tower fire; it represents the lightning that started it. It resembles a sabre-toothed tiger with a storm-cloud mane. It does not evolve; the Paradox Pokémon Raging Bolt is said to be an ancient relative.
description.tagline: The thunder tiger, born of the bolt that burned Brass Tower
